title: Leaving Doubt
narrator: al-Ḥasan bin ʿAlī bin Abī Ṭālib
arabic_text: عن [أبي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ بنِ عليِّ بنِ أبي طالِبٍ]، سِبْطِ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ورَيْحانَتِهِ رَضِي اللهُ عَنْهُما قالَ: (حَفِظْتُ مِنْ messenger of Allah صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: "دَعْ مَا يَرِيبُكَ إِلَى مَا لاَ يَرِيبُكَ").
english_translation: From Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan bin ʿAlī bin Abī Ṭālib, the grandson of the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam) and his sweet fragrance (raḍiyallāhu ʿanhu) who said: I memorized from the Messenger of Allāh (ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wasallam), 'Leave that which makes you doubt for that which does not make you doubt.'
description: This Hadith advises to abandon anything that causes suspicion or uncertainty for that which is clear and certain. It was narrated by al-Ḥasan bin ʿAlī and classified as ḥasan saḥīḥ by Tirmidhī.
